import Mathlib

structure BinaryMaxHeap where
  storage : List Int
deriving Inhabited

namespace BinaryMaxHeap

def len (h : BinaryMaxHeap) : Nat :=
  h.storage.length

def get (h : BinaryMaxHeap) (i : Nat) : Int :=
  h.storage.getD i 0 -- Safe access with default

def parent (i : Nat) : Nat := (i - 1) / 2

def is_heap (h : BinaryMaxHeap) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, 0 < i ∧ i < h.len → h.get i ≤ h.get (parent i)

def view (h : BinaryMaxHeap) : Multiset Int :=
  Multiset.ofList h.storage

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def push_precond (h : BinaryMaxHeap) (v : Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_heap h ∧ h.len < 1023 -- Limited capacity as per spec example
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def insertDesc (x : Int) : List Int → List Int
  | [] => [x]
  | y :: ys =>
      if x ≥ y then
        x :: y :: ys
      else
        y :: insertDesc x ys

def sortDesc : List Int → List Int
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => insertDesc x (sortDesc xs)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def push (h : BinaryMaxHeap) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : push_precond h v) : BinaryMaxHeap :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  ⟨sortDesc (h.storage ++ [v])⟩
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def push_postcond (h : BinaryMaxHeap) (v : Int) (result : BinaryMaxHeap)
    (_ : push_precond h v) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_heap result ∧
  result.len = h.len + 1 ∧
  result.view = h.view + {v}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma mem_insertDesc (x z : Int) (l : List Int) :
    z ∈ insertDesc x l ↔ z = x ∨ z ∈ l := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp [insertDesc]
  | cons a t ih =>
      simp only [insertDesc]
      split <;> simp [ih, or_left_comm]

lemma perm_insertDesc (x : Int) (l : List Int) :
    List.Perm (insertDesc x l) (x :: l) := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp [insertDesc]
  | cons a t ih =>
      simp only [insertDesc]
      split
      · exact List.Perm.refl _
      · exact
          (List.Perm.cons a ih).trans
            (List.Perm.swap a x t).symm

lemma perm_sortDesc (l : List Int) :
    List.Perm (sortDesc l) l := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      exact List.Perm.nil
  | cons x xs ih =>
      simp only [sortDesc]
      exact
        (perm_insertDesc x (sortDesc xs)).trans
          (List.Perm.cons x ih)

lemma length_sortDesc (l : List Int) :
    (sortDesc l).length = l.length := by
  exact (perm_sortDesc l).length_eq

lemma ofList_sortDesc (l : List Int) :
    Multiset.ofList (sortDesc l) = Multiset.ofList l := by
  apply Multiset.coe_eq_coe.mpr
  exact perm_sortDesc l

lemma ofList_append_singleton (l : List Int) (x : Int) :
    Multiset.ofList (l ++ [x]) = Multiset.ofList l + {x} := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp
  | cons a t ih =>
      change
        {a} + Multiset.ofList (t ++ [x]) =
          ({a} + Multiset.ofList t) + {x}
      rw [ih]
      exact
        (add_assoc ({a} : Multiset Int)
          (Multiset.ofList t) ({x} : Multiset Int)).symm

lemma pairwise_insertDesc (x : Int) {l : List Int}
    (hl : l.Pairwise (fun a b : Int => b ≤ a)) :
    (insertDesc x l).Pairwise (fun a b : Int => b ≤ a) := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp [insertDesc]
  | cons a t ih =>
      cases hl with
      | cons hhead htail =>
          simp only [insertDesc]
          split_ifs with h
          · apply List.Pairwise.cons
            · intro z hz
              simp only [List.mem_cons] at hz
              rcases hz with rfl | hz
              · exact h
              · exact le_trans (hhead z hz) h
            · exact List.Pairwise.cons hhead htail
          · apply List.Pairwise.cons
            · intro z hz
              rw [mem_insertDesc] at hz
              rcases hz with rfl | hz
              · exact (lt_of_not_ge h).le
              · exact hhead z hz
            · exact ih htail

lemma pairwise_sortDesc (l : List Int) :
    (sortDesc l).Pairwise (fun a b : Int => b ≤ a) := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      simp [sortDesc]
  | cons x xs ih =>
      simp only [sortDesc]
      exact pairwise_insertDesc x ih

lemma getD_mem_of_lt {α : Type} (l : List α) (d : α)
    {i : Nat} (hi : i < l.length) :
    l.getD i d ∈ l := by
  induction l generalizing i with
  | nil =>
      simp at hi
  | cons a t ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero =>
          simp [List.getD]
      | succ i =>
          have hm : t.getD i d ∈ t := ih (by simpa using hi)
          simpa [List.getD] using List.mem_cons_of_mem a hm

lemma pairwise_getD {l : List Int}
    (hs : l.Pairwise (fun a b : Int => b ≤ a))
    {i j : Nat} (hij : i < j) (hj : j < l.length) :
    l.getD j 0 ≤ l.getD i 0 := by
  induction l generalizing i j with
  | nil =>
      simp at hj
  | cons a t ih =>
      cases hs with
      | cons hhead htail =>
          cases i with
          | zero =>
              cases j with
              | zero =>
                  omega
              | succ j =>
                  change t.getD j 0 ≤ a
                  apply hhead
                  apply getD_mem_of_lt
                  simpa using hj
          | succ i =>
              cases j with
              | zero =>
                  omega
              | succ j =>
                  change t.getD j 0 ≤ t.getD i 0
                  exact ih htail
                    (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hij)
                    (by simpa using hj)

lemma parent_lt {i : Nat} (hi : 0 < i) :
    parent i < i := by
  unfold parent
  omega

lemma is_heap_of_pairwise {l : List Int}
    (hs : l.Pairwise (fun a b : Int => b ≤ a)) :
    is_heap ⟨l⟩ := by
  intro i hi
  change l.getD i 0 ≤ l.getD (parent i) 0
  exact pairwise_getD hs (parent_lt hi.1) hi.2
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem push_postcond_satisfied (h : BinaryMaxHeap) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : push_precond h v) :
    push_postcond h v (push h v h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  constructor
  · apply is_heap_of_pairwise
    exact pairwise_sortDesc _
  · constructor
    · simp [push, len, length_sortDesc]
    · change
        Multiset.ofList (sortDesc (h.storage ++ [v])) =
          Multiset.ofList h.storage + {v}
      rw [ofList_sortDesc]
      exact ofList_append_singleton h.storage v
  -- !benchmark @end proof

end BinaryMaxHeap
